title: Difficulty-Aware Semantic-ID Optimization for Generative Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2608.20611v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Semantic-ID-based generative recommendation casts retrieval and ranking as autoregressive generation over hierarchical item identifiers. A common recipe is SFT followed by GRPO, yet vanilla GRPO is poorly matched to this tree-structured task. Under the frozen SFT checkpoint, the exact target is absent from the first 16 candidates of the 50-beam constrained ranking for many prompts, and in harder cases none of these candidates enters the target SID branch. This prompt-level diagnostic motivates a training concern: when on-policy GRPO groups are similarly target-missing, item-level rewards may produce weak or degenerate reward variation even if some candidates follow part of the target path. We propose Difficulty-Aware Semantic-ID Optimization (DASO), a tree-aware post-training method that addresses this failure mode as an online rollout-allocation problem. translated_title: 难度感知的语义ID优化用于生成式推荐
translated_abstract: 基于语义ID的生成式推荐将检索和排序转化为对分层项目标识符的自回归生成。常见的方法是先进行监督微调（SFT），然后使用GRPO，但原始的GRPO与这种树状结构任务匹配不佳。在冻结的SFT检查点下，对于许多提示，精确目标在50束约束排序的前16个候选中缺失，在更难的情况下，这些候选均未进入目标语义ID分支。这种提示级诊断引发了一个训练问题：当同策略GRPO组类似地缺少目标时，即使某些候选遵循目标路径的一部分，项目级奖励也可能产生微弱或退化的奖励变化。我们提出难度感知的语义ID优化（DASO），一种树感知的后训练方法，将这一失败模式作为在线展开分配问题来解决。它不使用固定的难度桶或均匀注入地面真值补充。
tldr: 本文提出DASO方法，通过在线展开分配机制解决生成式推荐中树状结构下GRPO训练时目标缺失导致的奖励退化问题，从而提升语义ID生成推荐的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DASO, a tree-aware post-training method that addresses the target-missing reward degeneration issue in GRPO for semantic-ID-based generative recommendation via online rollout allocation.
